posts.title: AI loops: who pays for the tokens?
posts.description: A recent trend in AI has become this idea of "loops". Rather than you doing prompting and working with the AI to design and implement, you instead give it a higher level goal and let it roll. You build a system to let the AI make decisions, build and verify its work, all with the aim of completing your goal.
